يصطبحوا (form VIII)
# يَصْطَبِحُوا (yaṣṭabiḥū) /jasˤ.tˤa.bi.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# يُصْطَبَحُوا (yuṣṭabaḥū) /jusˤ.tˤa.ba.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
